goal: Under the phase strategy a completed phase archives only when its integration branch tip is an ancestor of the true base, with unmerged and merged-but-not-ancestor states left active under distinct visible reasons and the same predicate enforced by every archival caller.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-orchestrator packages/flywheel-worktree packages/flywheel

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- archive_completed_phases and its _cmd_archive CLI caller (which today invokes the sweep without gates -- predicate parity closes that bypass); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- archive_phases, the daemon caller that threads repo_root/phase_verify/claims; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_tui.py -- the third archival caller; must route through the same predicate
references: .flywheel/specs/00077-FEATURE-phase-archival-integrity.md -- the landed-not-merely-DONE predicate this extends one level up; its strand semantics must stay intact
constraints: Merged-ness is git ancestry -- the phase branch tip is an ancestor of the true base -- never a remote PR state string

While unmerged, repeated sweeps leave the phase directory under active/, surface the open PR as the blocking reason, and never advance the true base themselves (the worker performs no local merge of the phase branch)
A merged-but-not-ancestor state (squash or rebase merge on the remote) leaves the phase active under a distinct merge-method-mismatch reason, never the generic block and never a silent forever-loop
On ancestry the next sweep archives with the existing .loop-base materialization and stop-event semantics intact
Every archival caller (worker daemon, flywheel archive CLI, console) honors the same predicate when the strategy is phase; the gateless CLI/TUI sweep must not remain a one-command bypass
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: No PR-freshness or rebase automation for open phase PRs -- conflicts resolve at merge time by design (spec decision D-5)
No change to archival behavior for repos on the merge or pr strategies
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Criterion 5: after a merge-commit merge in the harness, the phase archives and git revert -m 1 of that merge commit applies cleanly
Criterion 6 mutation: a predicate that trusts a merged flag while ancestry fails must fail the behavior test's squash-merge case
Repeated sweeps against an unmerged PR are idempotent -- no duplicate blocking records, no directory churn
Spec 00077 strand semantics unchanged: a DONE-but-parked task still blocks archival independently of the PR predicate
